title: Rundeck: In Eclipse Jetty, across various versions of `jetty-security`, and `jetty-eeN-security`, two… (CVE-2026-18662)
description: CVE-2026-18662 is a security vulnerability in the Rundeck package related to Eclipse Jetty components. The issue arises from improper combination of multiple security constraints that share the same HTTP method omission set but lack URL patterns, violating the Jakarta Servlet Specification. This flaw affects versions of Rundeck prior to 6.0.1-r11. The vulnerability has a medium severity score of 6.9 and does not currently have known exploits in the wild. A patch is available in version 6.0.1-r11.
